findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an automated comment-diff backstop (e.g., extract tokenize.COMMENT tokens per file and require every non-allowlisted comment to be byte-identical HEAD^..HEAD) so the 'all other prose unchanged' AC is enforced for comments, not just docstrings.
evidence: Plan: 'strip only allowlisted owner docstrings, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require remaining AST/runtime equality plus directive/shebang physical-line equality'
Allowlist includes comment blocks, e.g. '_is_active_link::comment(SNAPSHOT fallback)@92-97' and multiple reads.py '::comment(...)' entries
AST does not carry comments, so AST equality is invariant to any comment change (allowlisted or not); directive/shebang physical-line equality covers only those lines, not general prose comments
AC line 1: 'Exactly the 36 allowlisted blocks are shortened; all other prose/directives are unchanged' — this holds for docstrings via AST but has no automated backstop for comments
findings.finding: The automated verification oracle (AST/runtime equality after stripping allowlisted docstrings + directive/shebang physical-line equality) cannot detect out-of-allowlist COMMENT edits, because comments are not represented in the Python AST and the physical-line check only covers directives/shebangs — yet the allowlist explicitly includes comment blocks, so the AC 'all other prose/directives are unchanged' is unenforced for non-allowlisted comments except by the human TSV reviewer.
findings.location: Verification and independent review; Acceptance Criteria line 1
scenarios: An author (or a bad merge) alters a non-allowlisted comment in one of the five files; AST/runtime equality still passes and path diff-check still shows only the five expected paths, so the automated oracle reports clean
A subtle unintended comment edit slips past the human reviewer's 36-row TSV, which only enumerates the intended 36 blocks
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the oracle with a comment-level check: using tokenize, collect all comment tokens per file, subtract the allowlisted comment ranges, and assert the remaining comment set is byte-identical between HEAD^ and HEAD (mirroring how AST equality already backstops non-allowlisted docstrings).

evidence: 2 criterion line(s) bundle multiple deliverables with 'and' (split so each is independently verifiable).
findings.suggested_fix: Split compound criteria, replace subjective terms with observable outcomes, and state how each is verified.
